description: FailLoud is a deterministic verification harness for LLM agent outputs — it catches the silent failures agents ship as 'done.' It deterministically checks agent outputs for placeholder content shipped as done, claimed actions with no evidence, stale state, counts that contradict the record, missing components, and RAG answers unsupported by their sources — no LLM in the verdict path.
name: io.github.Yalakala-Naveen/failloud
title: FailLoud
